summary: CKGSB is in launch week for the CKGSB-IE report and the Tech in Asia luncheon, while simultaneously advancing the knowledge website redesign and prioritising Asia Star and Intelligent China for global marketing.
summaryDetail: The immediate focus is the CKGSB-IE report launch on September 15: the webpage must be shared ahead of launch, social media promotion is underway, and final touches include sending Dean Xiang's speech recording and photos from Ira to Julie, plus approving last-minute luncheon registrants and confirming alumni attendance. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is moving forward with Joseph's HTML design to be shared and specific feedback to be provided by Joseph, Julie, and the team, following decisions to disperse videos by topic and integrate BCI and BSI indices. Marketing priorities remain on Asia Star and Intelligent China, with Manaferra's copy changes for the Intelligent China page and the Emerging Tech Management Week rewrite under review, while US programs are on hold. This week also requires operational follow-through: resolving the Outlook account lockout across all devices and contacting JSB to confirm the backend unlock. Upcoming, the team must analyse existing participant profiles, clarify conversion tracking definitions, and promote the August 2026 Business Conditions Index to the network.
